verdict.rationale: Missive documents assigning conversations to a team or a specific person while keeping visibility. It also documents conditional rules that act on conversations, including an escalation example that reassigns unanswered support emails, plus rules on paid plans (up to 1000). Together these cover explicit ownership and rule-based routing. missing for 10: detailed docs on rule conditions that route newly arrived mail to an assignee or team, and independent hands-on corroboration of assignment and routing.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: Assign conversations to a team or specific person, while maintaining visibility.
Each step waits, checks its own conditions, then acts on the same conversation.
Escalate unanswered support emails: label at 24 hrs, notify the lead at 48, reassign at 72.
